k-drive-launcher.name: K-Drive Launcher
k-drive-launcher.description: Summons a K-Drive for use during free roam missions

kahl-beacon.name: Kahl Beacon
kahl-beacon.description: Calls Kahl and a retinue of his Brothers to assist you for a limited time. Subsequent uses heal Kahl's squad and add an additional Brother.

kaithe-summon.name: Kaithe Summon
kaithe-summon.description: Summon and instantly mount a Kaithe while in free roam missions.

kinetic-siphon-trap.name: Kinetic Siphon Trap
kinetic-siphon-trap.description: Specialized trap for attracting and slowing the movement of synthesis targets.

kriller-bait.name: Kriller Bait
kriller-bait.description:
This bait is synthesized from Methacalcene-1 that is known to attract Krillers, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis lakes during warm weather.

Obtained via The Business in Fortuna (Venus).

kuaka-echo-lure.name: Kuaka Echo-Lure
kuaka-echo-lure.description: Entice and attract nearby Kuaka with life-like animal calls. Kuaka inhabit the Plains of Eidolon.

kuaka-pheromone-oota.name: Kuaka Pheromone Oota
kuaka-pheromone-oota.description: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Kuaka.

kubrodon-echo-lure.name: Kubrodon Echo-Lure
kubrodon-echo-lure.description: Entice and attract nearby Kubrodon with life-like animal calls. The Kubrodon is most often found around the Craters in Orb Vallis.

kubrodon-pheromone-synthesizer.name: Kubrodon Pheromone Synthesizer
kubrodon-pheromone-synthesizer.description: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Kubrodon.
